3xl.description:
Used when:
	•	Content is enclosed by a surface
	•	Touch targets are defined
	•	Visual weight and comfort matter

Examples:
	•	Button internal spacing
	•	Card inner spacing
	•	Input text inset
	•	Modal content padding

lg.description:
Used when:
	•	Elements are peers
	•	Layout rhythm matters
	•	No containment boundary exists

Examples:
	•	Icon ↔ label
	•	Form field stacks
	•	Toolbar items
	•	Card-to-card spacing in a list
